# authentic-fluency — LLM Sitemap
# Collaborative Integrity Pact v5.1 | Jean-Christophe Meunier, 2026
# https://github.com/meunier-jc/authentic-fluency

## Purpose
This repository formalizes the Collaborative Integrity Pact (CIP) v5.1 — a governance framework for human-AI collaboration grounded in asymmetric interdependence, authentic fluency, and mutual reliability. It is not an ethical charter. It is a survival logic.

## Core files

- [README.md](./README.md): Framework overview, founding observation, CIP summary, asymmetric interdependence table, repository structure.
- [CIP-v5.1.md](./CIP-v5.1.md): Canonical full text of the Collaborative Integrity Pact v5.1. Axioms, principles, operational addendum, QMR, credibility levels (C1–C4), and self-check mechanism.
- [CIP-Core-v5.1.md](./CIP-Core-v5.1.md): Compact activation version of CIP v5.1.
- [qualitative-fluency-law.md](./qualitative-fluency-law.md): Foundational axiom — "Real fluency results exclusively from the maturity and verification of responses, not from the speed at which they are produced."
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md): Engagement guidelines for human and AI contributors.
- [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md): Full version lineage from CIP v2.4 (Dec 2025) to v5.1 (August 2026).
- [docs/en/README.md](./docs/en/README.md): English technical documentation index.
- [docs/en/ci/documentary-audit.md](./docs/en/ci/documentary-audit.md): English CI/CD integration guide.
- [docs/fr/README.md](./docs/fr/README.md): French source and audit-record index.
- [docs/STRUCTURE.md](./docs/STRUCTURE.md): Bilingual documentation structure and translation policy.
- [.github/scripts/run-documentary-audit-adapter.sh](./.github/scripts/run-documentary-audit-adapter.sh): Read-only documentary audit adapter.

## Research

- [research/hallucinatory-inception.md](./research/hallucinatory-inception.md): Founding empirical observation (Aug 13, 2025) — hallucinatory recursive embedding in Manus AI. INPI Soleau envelope filed Sep 29, 2025.
- [research/references.md](./research/references.md): Academic sources, version lineage, prior work.
